components.name: ClinicalBenefit
components.description: Expected reduction in harm/mortality from rapid diagnostic scan/lab results

components.name: Urgency
components.description: Clinical time-to-harm window requiring immediate diagnostic imaging

components.name: DelayImpact
components.description: Harm caused by additional waiting for scan/lab results

components.name: ThroughputImpact
components.description: Unlocking downstream beds, queues, and clinical workflows

components.name: OperationalImpact
components.description: Reduction in operational strain, surgery cancellation, or ER crowding

components.name: FinancialImpact
components.description: Secondary financial consequence / revenue impact (kept low to prioritize clinical safety)

components.name: AlternativePenalty
components.description: Penalty applied when viable alternative diagnostics or safe holding options (HDU/PACU) exist

components.name: ResourceStressPenalty
components.description: Opportunity cost of consuming scarce diagnostic scanner capacity under high hospital load
